comment: Photo gallery screen (/diary/:slug/photos): head row, the list's category filter (diary_category, with a clear chip), month groups ('2026년 10월 · 사진 12장') of square thumbnails — wide 5 columns, narrow 3 — with the category emoji (top left) and the diary date (bottom left); a cell opens the post. Secret posts the viewer cannot open are one lock cell without an address (D6 / D83). Display mode and page size from the settings (infinite / page turning). Framed like the board list (template Container py-8 — D96).
